scope: geometry runtime only; actual Isaac and build-specific safety contracts pending

policy.authority: User: retain reproducible positive runtime gains of any magnitude only when capability does not regress; independently ablate each retained optimization.
policy.timing: Magnitude-free requirement and eight balanced geometry batches were fixed before timing in geometry/plan.json. This assessment implementation was finalized after timing; it is not a new preregistered statistical trial.

geometry.reproducible_direction: Paired batch bootstrap descriptive 95% CI excludes zero and at least 75% of complete batches point the same way. Zero-only differences are unchanged; all other mixed/uncertain results are unresolved_variation, not proof of benefit or harm.
geometry.benefit: At least one all-group wall mean or P95 shows reproducible gain. Report every wall/CPU subgroup mean/P95/max; reproducible harm in any of those prevents adopting that contrast. An unresolved negative estimate remains explicit and cannot be claimed equivalent.
hard_gates: exact complete stdout equality to baseline including finite continuous outputs
geometry.independent_unit: A complete balanced batch, never 37 frames treated as 37 independent repetitions
geometry.pooled: Always report pooled summaries separately. Pooled P95 is not the mean of per-batch P95; a contrary pooled point estimate must remain visible.
geometry.scope: Geometry eligibility only. Full controller safety contracts and actual task capability require the Isaac stage. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

isaac.order: Driver's frozen order_by_repeat; actual post-lock launch sequence verified. Three four-variant blocks are interleaved but not a complete four-block Latin design.
hard_gates: same scene/physics/input and six flags off/callback
selected unknown/expired/stale-command negative contracts on the candidate build
isaac.comparison: Same repeat and case paired, four required independent/incremental contrasts. Report raw values, absolute and relative changes, standard deviations, maxima, sign counts, descriptive paired-bootstrap interval. Any reproducible adverse task metric is reported separately and blocks automatic retention of that contrast; no favorable aggregate may cancel it.
isaac.small_sample: Three pairs are an initial engineering check, not population noninferiority. CI crossing zero is unresolved, not equivalent or worse by decree. Existing exact-output and negative-case evidence can support provisional retention with no demonstrated regression; root must state unresolved task fluctuations. Add only targeted pairs when a material adverse signal remains ambiguous, never an automatic old five-pair confirmation requirement.
isaac.reproducible_direction: Same CI and 75% direction rule; with three pairs that requires all three signs. No fixed gain magnitude, sign-test significance, or 10%/1% threshold is required.
isaac.runtime_gain: A validated geometry gain is sufficient runtime benefit; task arrival/jerk need not also improve. Actual task checks guard capability and must not be described as navigation acceleration without evidence.
isaac.contracts_scope: Selected regression fixtures only; never proof that all real unknown/expired/stale situations are covered. Missing evidence remains unknown.

ci_scope: Reviewed frozen geometry/analyze_ablation.py generated the supplied 20000 paired batch bootstrap intervals; this collector independently recomputes raw summaries, pairing, effect and signs. Intervals are descriptive and unadjusted.
